A '''species''' once inhabited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jandoon]]. Several [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the species went extinct but none ever learned what exactly happened to them. Rumors sprang up, with tales about angry spirits that stalked the planet keeping most travelers away from Jandoon.
